{{Quote|Landing pad X-1256 AEB. Remember the number if we get lost and split up.|Eddey Be'ray|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Landing pad X-1256 AEB''',<ref name="Scourge" /> also known as '''landing dock X1256 AEB''', was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="TF" /> that was in use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]<ref name="Scourge" /> traveled to Nar Shaddaa to attended a banquet hosted by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] and docked their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]'' landing pad X-1256 AEB. There, they were awaited by Popara's son [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[H-3POB]]. In an ruse to conceal Mika's involvement in the distribution of the dangerous [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]], Mika arranged for the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Ogo Nan]] to fire on the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] accompanying him as he awaited the crew of the ''New Ambition'', making it appear that Mika had been targeted for assassination.<ref name="TF" />
